item.title: Xiaomi 17 Ultra European pricing leaks, and it’s good news
item.description: Details concerning the Xiaomi 17 Ultra’s European launch have leaked online, including the crucial matters of pricing and battery size. Leaker MysteryLupin has taken to X to reveal some key details about the global launch of the Xiaomi 17 Ultra, which is expected to occur alongside the rest of the Xiaomi 17 series within a month. item.title: Nothing Phone (4a) and Pro get tipped release date
item.description: The Nothing Phone (4a) and Nothing Phone (4a) Pro should be launching in around a month’s time, according to a fresh tip. Leaker Yogesh Brar has claimed that the Nothing Phone (4a) mid-range smartphone duo will be launching “globally by early March”, with a tentative date of 5 March. The tipster also provides a brief list outlining the Nothing Phone (4a) and (4a) Pro’s key attributes. item.title: Where to watch (earlier adaptations of) Wuthering Heights free
item.description: The first adaptation of Emily Brontë’s Romantic novel dates back to the 1920s, though copies of it have been lost. In the following decades, filmmakers continued to adapt Wuthering Heights, as feature films and TV series. However, they rarely captured the novel’s bone-deep passion and psychological complexity. item.title: Google confirms that AirDrop for all is right around the corner
item.description: Google has confirmed that its support for Apple’s AirDrop file sharing feature is coming to more Android phones “very soon”. During a press briefing at Google’s Taipei office, Vice President of Engineering for the Android platform Eric Kay revealed that the ability for Android Quick Share to work with iOS AirDrop would be coming to non-Pixel smartphones in 2026. item.title: All four Pixel 10a colours ranked, from “murky” to “fun-adjacent”
item.description: Google will announce its Pixel 10a mid-range smartphone on 18 February, and we already have a good idea of what’s in store. Thanks to a series of leaks, the Google Pixel 10a design is a pretty much a known quantity at this point. In a nutshell, it’s going to look a lot like the Google Pixel 9a. The most recent leak we’ve seen concerns the Pixel 10a’s colour options. item.title: You might want to wait for one of the new, cheap iPads
item.description: Apples cheaper iPad tablet models could be set for some significant upgrades. Apple’s cheaper tablet options are also very strong, but it can often feel like they’re somewhat neglected by Apple when it comes to keeping their spec sheets up to date. item.title: The Pixel’s At A Glance widget is getting a redesign
item.description: In an ideal world, you’d be able to remove the At A Glance widget from your Pixel. It’s one of our biggest bugbears with the Pixel home screen. In fact, there’s evidence that Google will give you the option to do just that, and we expect the feature to be available in the Android 16 QPR3 update in March. item.title: HBO Max is coming to the UK this March – and here’s what it costs
item.description: For years, UK viewers have received most HBO content broadcast in the US via Sky or a Now Entertainment Membership, with a few exceptions such as comedy hit Hacks. However, it’s now certain that HBO Max will finally launch in the United Kingdom. Its arrival has long been anticipated, but the details weren’t clear.
